test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A pipe can fill a tank in 15 hours. Another pipe can empty the filled tank in 24 hours. If both the pipes are opened simultaneously, then the time in which the tank will be filled is:
solution:
Given:

Time taken by the pipe to fill the tank = 15 hours

Another pipe can empty the filled tank in 24 hours.

Concept used:

If a tap can fill/empty a tank in x hours then the tank filled/emptied by the tap in 1 hour = 1/x of the total tank.

Calculation:

Total quantity of tank = LCM of 24 and 15 = 120

Efficiency of filling pipe = 120/15 = 8 unit/m

Efficiency of pipe emptying = 120/24 = 5 unit/m

Effective efficiency = 8 - 5 = 3 unit/m

Time to fill together = 120/3 = 40 hours.

∴ The answer is 40 hours
